universal_lens: The CDF formalizes a multi-agent dynamical system via synchronized discrete-time sampling. It unifies spatial coordinates, temporal markers, and event topologies into a single rigorous state-space representation, establishing an isomorphic mapping between continuous physical field dynamics and quantized digital observables for invariant analysis. A unified formalism for structured event and tracking data using JSON Lines, enabling modular inference across temporal and spatial dimensions.
gsi_mapping: GSI treats the CDF tracking data as a high-dimensional time series. Bayesian filtering infers latent player intentions from noisy coordinate streams, while conformal prediction bounds the uncertainty of future ball possession states, ensuring robust probabilistic guarantees across varying vendor sampling rates. Bayesian probabilistic models infer match states and player actions from JSON-Lines event streams, conditioning on observed centroids and skeletal landmarks.
gse_mapping: GSE utilizes the monotonically increasing frame identifiers to construct a deterministic finite automaton of match states. Transitions between 'in play' and 'out of play' are triggered by event timestamps, enabling precise situational reasoning and real-time tactical state evaluation. Situation-aware state transitions in GSE are encoded through JSON-Lines structures, mapping frame-level tracking to high-dimensional tactical configurations.

primitives.name: Player Outplay Metric
primitives.verbatim_quote: Using this approach, a player is outplayed when the player is closer to their own goal than the ball at the time of the pass and further away from the goal than the ball at time of reception.
primitives.latex: \text{Outplay}(p, e) = \begin{cases} 1 & \text{if } d(p, g_{own}) < d(b, g_{own}) \land d(p, g_{opp}) > d(b, g_{opp}) \\ 0 & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'p': 'player identifier', 'e': 'event identifier', 'd(\\cdot, \\cdot)': 'Euclidean distance in meters', 'g_{own}': 'own goal position vector', 'g_{opp}': 'opponent goal position vector', 'b': 'ball position vector'}
primitives.assumptions: Ball and player positions are known at pass initiation and reception times; goals are static.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When positional data is unavailable or ambiguous, the metric cannot be computed.

layer2.mapping: Computed from spatial relationships between player, ball, and goal positions across event duration.
layer2.telemetry: Binary indicator of outplay occurrence per event.

primitives.name: Horizontal Packing Approach
primitives.verbatim_quote: Using this approach, a player is outplayed when their horizontal line is crossed by the ball during the pass, i.e., between the time of the pass and the time of reception.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'x_b(t)': 'ball x-coordinate at time t in meters', 'x_p(t)': 'player x-coordinate at time t in meters', 't_{pass}': 'pass initiation time in seconds', 't_{recv}': 'reception time in seconds'}
primitives.assumptions: Pass trajectory is linear; horizontal line is defined by player's x-position at pass initiation.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When ball path deviates significantly from linear or when player moves vertically during pass.

layer2.mapping: Measures whether ball crosses player's horizontal projection during event duration.
layer2.telemetry: Count of opposing players whose horizontal lines are crossed by the ball during pass.
